current_status.from: Active as of 2026-09-23. Nottingham voters approved the Temporary Moratorium on Data Centers Ordinance 1,335-143 at the September 8, 2026 special town election. The ordinance is now in legal effect townwide for 12 months (through approximately September 8, 2027), prohibiting acceptance, processing, or approval of permits or approvals for the establishment, construction, expansion, or operation of data centers in every zoning district. No repeal or amendment was found in sources reviewed through 2026-09-23.
